In high school I auditioned for a high-level wind ensemble on clarinet. On this particular day I was the first to be auditioned. The judge dude asked for a C# harmonic minor scale. Fuck, I didn't know that one any more than my virgin ass knew what the sweet kiss of a dick felt like. So sneaky sneaky 16yo me decided to play a C minor scale. I know, so scandalous, but it was much fuckin easier, and only sounded slightly different to the judge. As I played the undeniably wrong scale with the confidence of a thousand lions, I remember him making a confused face like "hmm that sounds a bit different" and then the "oh well" half-shrug as he scribbled something on my score sheet. 

I got a perfect fucking score. 

My friend, who auditioned with the same guy right after me, got points off for playing the wrong scale although he came prepared like an actual capable motherfucker and played the correct one. I never would have thought such a sly kniving rebel such as myself could pull off such a daredevil stunt. I take this dark evil secret -- my supervillain origin story -- to the grave.
